# OptimalX PLAN-final: gated batch plan (planner, 2026-09-18)

Supersedes PLAN.md (conductor draft v1). Inputs read in full: PLAN.md, engine-surface.md (cited as ES section:line), DIRECTION.md (cited as D section, amendments A1 to A9 carried in), design-constraints.md, B0-progress.md, research/FINAL-content.md (1743 lines, sections 1 to 9 present), FINAL-catalogue.md, salla-ids.json (47 ids), keywords-ar.md section 7, the repo at HEAD 5464b3a, and the engine dist where a fact needed re-checking (cited by dist path:line). Three builders share ONE working tree; nothing here asks two batches to touch the same file in the same wave.

Conventions: "owns" means create or modify; "reads" means import only. Every batch runs `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test`, `pnpm check:copy`, `pnpm check:jsonld`, `pnpm check:rtl`, `pnpm check:motion`, `pnpm check:strings`, `pnpm build` green before handing back (the four new checks are created in P0). Every UI string is a `t('ox.*')` key in a locale partial (section 2). Money in JSX only via `useMoney().format()` (ES 13.3:1712-1729); raw numbers plus "SAR" in JSON-LD. Description HTML is untrusted and only ever rendered through `sanitizeHtml` (B3).

## 2. Shared-file protocol: the seams are cut before any builder starts

Principle: the conductor cuts every shared seam in a serial prelude (P0), each batch then owns disjoint files, and generated files are regenerated by scripts, never edited by hand. A builder that needs a change in a file it does not own stops and asks the conductor; the conductor makes the change between waves.

### 2.1 P0 prelude (conductor, after B0 verification is green, before wave 0)

| Seam | What P0 does | Owner afterwards |
|---|---|---|
| Locales | Creates `locales/partials/README.md` and empty pairs `p1a.ar.json/p1a.en.json`, `p1b`, `b1`, `b2`, `b3`, `b4`, `b5`, `b6` (each `{}`); writes `scripts/i18n-merge.mjs` and `package.json` script `i18n:merge`; pre-fills `locales/ar.json` and `en.json` with every `ox.common.*` and `ox.a11y.*` key from FINAL-content 9.1 and 9.2 (28 keys) so nobody else adds to those two blocks | each batch owns its pair; `locales/ar.json` and `en.json` are owned by B7 only |
| Merge script contract | Reads base `locales/<lng>.json`, then every `locales/partials/*.<lng>.json`; refuses (exit 1, output untouched) on: unparsable JSON, a key not starting with `ox.`, a key present in two partials, a key already in the base that a partial redefines, ar/en key mismatch inside one pair; writes `locales/<lng>.json` sorted by key, atomically (temp file plus rename), stable formatting (2 spaces, trailing newline) | conductor runs it at the end of every wave; a builder may run it locally for `pnpm dev` (idempotent) |
| Tests over partials | Extends `tests/i18n.test.ts` to run the same parity and copy-lint rules over every partial pair in memory, and adds `tests/helpers/i18n.ts` (loads base plus partials into the mocked `useTranslation`) and `tests/helpers/render.tsx` | batches do not edit `tests/setup.tsx`; per-file `vi.mock` only |
| SCSS | Creates `app/styles/06-ox/_index.scss` importing, in this order, `_primitives`, `_blocks`, `_b1-layout`, `_b2-home`, `_b3-product`, `_b4-listing`, `_b5-pages`, `_b6-commerce` (each an empty stub), and appends one line `@import './06-ox/index';` at the end of `app/styles/app.scss` | each batch owns exactly its stub; nobody edits `_index.scss` or `app.scss` again |
| Components | Creates empty dirs with a `.gitkeep`: `app/components/{common,blocks,listing,pages,commerce}/`, `app/content/`; no barrels anywhere new (import by file path); `app/components/home/index.ts` and `product/index.ts` are frozen (B2 and B3 may edit their own) | per batch |
| Routes | Adds to `app/routes.ts`: `/services`, `/branch`, `/about`, `/contact`, `/tools/converter`; creates the five stub files mirroring `kitchen-sink.tsx` (no `// @auto-generated` line) rendering a dev-only "TODO B5" paragraph and `head` with `robots: noindex` | B5 |
| Router | Adds to `app/router.tsx` imports and calls of two new no-op modules: `app/components/commerce/register.ts` (`registerOxCommerceHooks`) and `app/components/listing/register.ts` (`registerOxListingHooks`) | B6 and B4 own their register files; `router.tsx` itself is touched again only by B6 in wave 2 (C10) |
| Kitchen sink | Rewrites `app/routes/kitchen-sink.tsx` to lazy-import `KitchenSink.tsx` from `common`, `blocks`, `layout`, `home`, `product`, `listing`, `pages`, `commerce` (stubs exporting an empty section) plus the fonts.check banner (D 3) and the html/body background assertion (D 10.1 rule 7) | each batch owns its section |
| twilight.json | Runs a patch script (same style as B0's) adding the seven settings in C7 under the existing "خيارات اوبتيمال اكس" title | B2 owns `components[]` in wave 2; settings are frozen after P0 |
| Scripts | Adds `scripts/check-rtl.mjs` (fails on physical properties or physical Tailwind utilities in `app/`: `margin-left|margin-right|padding-left|padding-right|^\s*(left|right):|text-align:\s*(left|right)|border-(left|right)|\b(ml|mr|pl|pr|left|right|text-left|text-right)-`), `scripts/check-motion.mjs` (fails on `filter: blur`, `backdrop-filter`, `will-change`, `translateZ`, `translate3d`, `transform-gpu`, `blur-`, `drop-shadow`, `letter-spacing: -` in app/; and on `transition` or `animation` inside rules whose selector contains `.ox-hero__photo`, `.ox-hero__stroke`, `.ox-hero__corner`, `.ox-band__wedge` per A9), `scripts/check-strings.mjs` (fails on Arabic script or quoted Latin sentences inside JSX text or string literals in `app/**/*.tsx`, allowlist: `app/content/salla-ids.ts`, test files); `package.json` scripts `check:rtl`, `check:motion`, `check:strings`, `check:all` | conductor |
| package.json | Frozen after P0. No batch adds a dependency. A batch that believes it needs one writes the case in its handback; the conductor decides between waves | conductor |
| `app/routes/__root.tsx` | Untouched in P0 | B5 in wave 2 (notFound and error components), nobody else |
| `app/components/seo/registerHeadHooks.tsx` | Untouched in P0 | B5 in wave 2 (adds the LocalBusiness node to the site-wide graph) |
| `tests/fixtures/jsonld/` | Untouched | each batch adds its own new fixture files (the `check:jsonld` glob picks them up) |

### 2.3 Other mechanical rules

- A file listed as "reads" for a batch is never modified by it, even for a typo; ask the conductor.
- New test files go under `tests/<batch-dir>/`; fixtures under `tests/fixtures/<batch-dir>/` except JSON-LD fixtures, which go to `tests/fixtures/jsonld/<batch>-*.json`.
- `app/routeTree.gen.ts` is generated; never edited, never diffed by hand.
- Route files a batch owns lose the `// @auto-generated` first line in that batch (ES 15.5:2056-2062).
- Deleting a dead scaffold file is allowed only for the batch that owns its directory, and only when `grep` shows zero importers.
- The Write tool and heredocs mangle backslash escapes (B0 tooling gotcha); any regex or `\u` escape in source is built from `String.fromCharCode` or verified with `xxd` after writing.

## 3. Wave order

| Wave | Concurrent | Needs from before | Ends with |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | B0 tail (conductor verifies) then P0 (conductor, serial, about 2 hours) then P1a and P1b (two builders) | B0 green | conductor runs `i18n:merge`, `check:all`, G3 on P1a and P1b |
| 1 | B1 (chrome), B3 (PDP and card), B4 (listing, goals, search) | P0 seams, P1a primitives and content, P1b blocks | merge, `check:all`, G1 on B3, G2 on B1/B3/B4, G3 on all three |
| 2 | B2 (home), B5 (pages, 404, error), B6 (commerce theming) | B1 header (B2 hero sits under it), B3 card (B2 slider, B6 wishlist grid), B4 ListingPage (B5 hub links, B6 brands) | merge, `check:all`, G1 on B5, G2 on B2/B5/B6, G3 on all three |
| 3 | B7 (content merge), B9 (docs and cleanup); B8 menu writes (conductor, after the owner creates categories) | everything | G4 on the whole build, GO or NO-GO |

At most three builders at once; the conductor never builds during a wave. B8 (store) is the conductor's and is mostly done: 47 products, 43 photos; what remains is the header menu write after categories exist, with read-back.

## 4. Batches

### P1a. Primitives, sprite, content maps (wave 0, one builder)

Goal: the vocabulary every batch composes from, so no later batch writes a button, a chip, a table or a copy block of its own.

Owns (create): `app/styles/tokens.css` (modify: add `--ox-line-3: #85858E` per A1; nothing else), `app/styles/06-ox/_primitives.scss`, `app/components/common/{Button,Chip,Badge,SectionHeader,Icon,Sprite,Skeleton,Price,Bdi,Accordion,EmptyState,Table,Tabs,Tooltip,KitchenSink}.tsx`, `app/components/common/hooks/{useReducedMotion,useMediaQuery,useIntersectionOnce}.ts`, `public/assets/icons/ox-sprite.svg`, `app/content/{goals,categories,services,branch,faq,thankyou,glossary}.ts`, `app/content/salla-ids.ts` (generated from research/salla-ids.json by a small script committed as `scripts/gen-salla-ids.mjs`), `locales/partials/p1a.*`, `tests/common/*.test.tsx`, `tests/content/*.test.ts`.
Reads: DIRECTION 2 to 5.7, 8.7, 9, 10; FINAL-content 2, 3, 4, 5, 6.4, 8; FINAL-catalogue A; tailwind.config.cjs.

Binding spec: D 2.6 role tokens and `.ox-band-dark`; D 2.7 focus ring, shadows, radii; D 3.1 to 3.4 type and bidi; D 4.4 equal heights; D 5.7 primitives with A2 (`--ox-line-3` rest border on inputs, checks, radios, filter chips, option pills, price track); D 5.6 Skeleton with A7 (static plate rectangles, pulse only on text bars of the one in-viewport root, driven by one `IntersectionObserver`); D 8.7 sprite (32 symbols, 24 grid, stroke 1.8 miter square, one `.ox-icon__accent` element each, never mirrored); `.ox-sr-only` clip utility and `.ox-container*` widths (D 10.1); wedge mixin `ox-wedge($band-h, $side)` that emits both the RTL polygon and the `[dir="ltr"]` override from D 4.5's table and never a transition (A9); `Price` renders `useMoney().format()` inside `unicode-bidi: isolate` (D 9.8 bidi row); `Bdi` sets `lang="en"` (A5); `SectionHeader` renders the eyebrow only when an `eyebrow` prop is given (A4) and the "عرض الكل" link with the mirrored chevron.

Content maps hold structure and locale keys, never copy: `goals.ts` (six slugs from FINAL-catalogue A.3, each with h1Key, introKey, subNeeds[{titleKey, lineKey, categorySlug, filter?}], faq[{qKey,aKey}], needHelpKey, skus, explainer only for goal-performance, two anchored groups for goal-ideal-weight); `categories.ts` (15 slugs from A.1 with parent, h1Key, titleKey, introKey, chips, faq, relatedGuides[3]); `services.ts` (three channels with OX code, badgeKey, metaKey, descKey, scope, prepareKey, outputKey, changeKey, ctaKey, howItWorks[3], faq); `branch.ts` (address, geo 24.46276125 / 39.653138015, settings ids it reads, hours parser for the `branch_hours` textarea into schema `openingHours` strings and a weekday table, pickup steps); `faq.ts` (home FAQ five items including the mandatory price item, PDP FAQ base items); `thankyou.ts` (general steps, per-category lines from FINAL-content 6.4, storage line); `glossary.ts` (nutrient name to plain-Arabic explanation key for the nutrition table's third column, 30 terms from section 8, plus the common label nutrients: protein, carbohydrates, fat, sugars, sodium, calories, creatine, caffeine, BCAA, vitamins by letter).

Engine primitives: `useMoney` (ES 5:362), `useTranslation` (ES 5:379), `SallaAccordion/Head/Body` (ES 9.2:1068-1074), `SallaTabs` (:1062-1066), `SallaTooltip` (in the 126 list), `Image` from `/common` with `srcSetWidths` capped at 2x the slot (ES 13.4:1749-1753; A8).

Tests: Button renders five variants and the loading state locks width; SectionHeader omits the eyebrow row when no eyebrow; Price output contains `sicon-sar` and the isolate wrapper; Bdi carries `lang="en"`; sprite file has exactly 32 `<symbol>` ids, each with one `.ox-icon__accent`, no `stroke-linecap="round"`, no `rx`; every key referenced by the content maps exists in the p1a partial (ar and en); goal slugs equal A.3; category slugs equal A.1; `salla-ids.ts` has 47 entries.

Acceptance (verifier): kitchen sink shows every primitive in every state at 390 and 1440 with no console error; `check:all` green; the sprite is under 16 KB.
Risks: the sprite drawing takes longer than the code (fallback: ship the 12 category and goal symbols first, the rest as the "tick" placeholder marked TODO-icon in the kitchen sink, listed in the handback); glossary coverage of real label nutrient names (fallback: a row with no explanation shows an empty third cell, never invented text).

### P1b. Shared blocks (wave 0, one builder, concurrent with P1a)

Goal: the blocks two or more pages reuse, built once.

Owns (create): `app/styles/06-ox/_blocks.scss`, `app/components/blocks/{OxBranch,HoursTable,ChannelCard,GuideCard,OxNewsletter,ProductsSliderWrapper,KitchenSink}.tsx`, `locales/partials/p1b.*`, `tests/blocks/*.test.tsx`.

Binding spec: cart = `Cart.Component` wrapped; `registerOxCommerceHooks()` registers `cart:items.end` (context `cartItems`, dist/routes/cart.js:100-123) rendering the trust lines and the free-shipping bar from `free_shipping_threshold` and `useCartContext().cart.sub_total` (the engine's `free_shipping_bar` field wins when present); the wrapper renders `CartEmpty` (FINAL-content 6.5 routes out) when `cart.count === 0` and the mobile `CheckoutBar` (64, sets body class `ox-sticky-bar` so the tab bar yields); head extend `robots: noindex, follow`. Thank-you = `ThankYou.Component` then `ThankYouBlocks` (steps from `content/thankyou.ts` by the ordered items' category slug, storage line, services nudge, pickup note when the order's shipping is pickup), noindex. Blog index = `Blog.Component` wrapped with `BlogIndexHeader` (h1 from 1.4 Guides) and OxNewsletter; blog single = `BlogSingle.Component` wrapped with `ArticleExtras` (key points parsed from a sanitised `<h2>الخلاصة</h2>` list when present, the disclaimer line, share row, related GuideCards, newsletter) and head extend adding `article(detail)` (B0 builder) with the C12 canonical. Brands = `Brands.Component` wrapped with the intro line (`ox.brands.intro`, B4's key, TODO-copy). Static pages = `PageSingle.Component` wrapped with `PolicyIntro` keyed by page slug (6.3). Account: no route ownership; AccountNav and the empty placeholders are styled through s-* classes on `CustomerLayout`; the engine placeholder copy stays because those pages expose no hook slot (documented). Stretch (C10): `router.update({ defaultViewTransition: true })` after `createRouter` plus the `::view-transition-*` rules and the four named groups of D 7.3, `none` under reduced motion, removed if G4 shows layout cost.
Claims: the VAT-inclusive note only when `vat_number` is set; payment marks only through `SallaPayments`.

Tests: CartTrust threshold math from settings; thank-you step selection by category slug; article JSON-LD fixture passes `check:jsonld`; policy intro lookup; each hook registered exactly once (handler count via `hookRegistry.getHandlers`).
Acceptance: `/ar/cart` empty and with two items at 390 and 1440 (summary sticky at 1440, checkout bar fixed at 390 and the tab bar hidden); thank-you on the kitchen-sink fixture order (live when the owner provides an order, Q14); `/ar/blog` and one article once pasted; `/ar/brands`; a policy page; account routes styled; console 0.
Risks: engine cart class names may change across engine versions (selectors pinned in one commented block); `free_shipping_bar` semantics unverified (threshold math only); no article on the store until the owner pastes one.

## 5. Gate plan

### 5.1 Claims gates (binding on every batch; checked at G2 and G4)

| Gate | Rule | Mechanism |
|---|---|---|
| Free shipping threshold | never a literal 299 in JSX or locale values; the interpolated `{threshold}` comes from `free_shipping_threshold` | `check:strings` gains a rule forbidding `299` in `app/` and `locales/` |
| Reply time | any reply promise renders only when `reply_sla_hours` is set and interpolates it | B1 trust strip, B2 services block, B5 hub and cards, B6 thank-you nudge |
| Payment marks | never a method name in text; marks only through `SallaPayments` | the FINAL-content lines naming مدى, أبل باي, تابي, فيزا are replaced by the marks row; `check:strings` forbids those tokens in locale values |
| VAT | the VAT-inclusive line and the VAT number only when `vat_number` is set | B1 footer, B3 price block, B6 cart |
| Official distributors | "موزعون رسميون" only when `claim_official_distributors` is true; else "منتجات أصلية" with the definition sentence | B2 trust strip, B3 TrustGrid and badge |
| Consultation credit | the 50 SAR line only when `consultation_credit_note` is non-empty, verbatim | B2 services block, B3 ServicePdp, B5 hub |

P0 addendum: `reply_sla_hours` (string/text, empty) joins the seven settings in C7.

### 5.2 G1 security (mastermind-security)

When: after wave 1 on B3; after wave 2 on B5 and B6; a final pass before G4. Scope: `sanitizeHtml` (allowlist, entity handling, attribute stripping, `javascript:` and `data:` hrefs, U+2028 and U+2029, nested and unterminated tags, the corpus in `tests/security/`); every `dangerouslySetInnerHTML` in `app/` (the inventory must be exactly: JSON-LD through `toScriptText`, sanitised description and article HTML; anything else fails); URL construction in the head helpers (origin from `store.url` only); `wa.me` links (digits only); the newsletter and converter inputs; `pnpm audit` 0 and no new dependency; no secret or `store.settings.keys.*` echoed except the maps key into `SallaMap`. Output: the delegation envelope; any high finding blocks the wave.

### 5.3 G2 UI (mastermind-designer)

Per batch on `pnpm build && pnpm preview` with chrome-devtools at 390x844 and 1440x900 in Arabic, plus `/en` at 1440 when the store is multilingual: every D 9.2 to 9.8 row (B rows block), the anti-template mapping 9.9 (at least four dimensions shown), block heights against D 6.x, one wedge per screen, D 7.1 rows with reduced motion emulated, the A1 to A9 amendments, and an explicit accept or refuse on each permutation a builder flagged (B3 buy-zone order). Lighthouse axe on each route. Findings in the delegation envelope.

### 5.4 G3 code review (mastermind-reviewer)

Per batch: the diff touches only owned files; owned routes carry no `// @auto-generated` line; hook slots and their context preserved; `t()` keys inside the owning block; no engine key shadowed; tests present and meaningful; `check:all` green; no new `any` beyond the components package's loose wrapper props; every engine fact in a comment cites its dist path.

### 5.5 G4 verifier (mastermind-verifier) and GO or NO-GO

Commands: `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test`, `pnpm check:all`, `pnpm build`, `pnpm preview`. Browser walk (chrome-devtools, Arabic at 390 and 1440, then `/en` at 1440 if multilingual): `/`, PDPs p1996831868, p1497955814, p1141798217, p702549495, p662137586, p487045117, a category (or `/latest-products` until categories exist), a goal landing (kitchen-sink fixture until goal categories exist), `/search?q=واي`, `/search?q=zzzz`, `/cart` empty and with items, `/services`, `/branch`, `/about`, `/contact`, `/tools/converter`, `/blog` and one article if present, `/brands`, a policy page, `/account/wishlist` logged out (login modal), `/no-such-page`. On each: theme-attributable console errors 0 (the engine's #418 is listed and excluded; anything else fails), one h1, `html[lang][dir]` correct, no horizontal scroll at 390 and 320, and on home, PDP and listing at 390 and 320 the probe from `mastermind-audit/references/mobile-render-budget.md` section 4 returns `filterMB 0, nBackdrop 0, forced 0, fixedOver 0, textClipUnderFilter 0, escaped 0, docW === vw`. Lighthouse twice on `/` and the PDP, quoted against the engine floor in BUILD.md 14 (LCP and CLS are disclosed, not gated; INP under 200 ms and zero theme-caused CLS are gated).
GO when every command is green, every walked route renders its D 6 composition, console and probe pass, G1 has no open high, G2 has no open B row, `locales/partials/` is gone, `git status` is clean except owner images, and the owner checklist names every remaining owner task. NO-GO otherwise, with the failing item named.
